products.name: Captions AI
products.note: AI video editing; eye contact correction; dubbing; likeness manipulation consent

profile_text.body:
Captions is an AI video generator and editor founded in 2021 and headquartered in New York City. The company describes itself as offering AI that edits videos with taste rather than just speed, with its tools understanding a user's story and tailoring edits to specific footage. Its platform is aimed at content creators of varying skill levels, covering use cases such as short-form social videos, ads, tutorials, product demos, and real estate listing videos.

The company's primary product, Captions AI, sits in the video generation and editing category and includes features such as automatic scene cutting, B-roll overlays, caption generation, and translated subtitle creation. The platform also offers eye contact correction, AI voiceovers, and the ability to create an AI twin or choose from digital avatars, with noted considerations around likeness manipulation consent. Additional tools include a prompt-to-video feature, script-to-video conversion, and a text-based video editor.

The held facts indicate Captions has a notable legal exposure footprint in New York, with 220 associated entries in that jurisdiction, though no specific litigation cases are recorded in the available data.
